newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ slowdown confirmed in national accounts - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ slowdown confirmed in national accounts - SNZ.

text.p: Continuing but slowing growth was confirmed in provisional national accounts to March, Statistics New Zealand said on Tuesday.
GDP is estimated to have risen 6.0 percent to $91.0 billion at current prices in the year to March against 6.9 percent in the year to March 1995.
It rose 3.1 percent at constant prices against 5.3 percent in the year to March 1995.
The shares of gross domestic product attributable to operating surplus and compensation of employees have remained stable over the last three years.
